title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Korea Pairing
items.text: Talor Gooch played alongside Bryson DeChambeau and Cam Smith during the third round of LIV Golf Korea on Saturday.

items.headline: PGA Tour Field Thinness
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the Charles Schwab Challenge field at Colonial Country Club features only one OWGR top-10 player.

items.headline: McIlroy’s Putter Advice
items.text: In February 2024, Rory McIlroy advised Scottie Scheffler at the Genesis Invitational to switch to a mallet-style putter to improve his margin for error.
